integrity.date_evidence: The exact public preprint date 2002-10-28 is verified at arxiv:math/0210428. The earlier Baclawski publication is dated only to December 1972 in the inspected issue, and no exact day for its first public release is asserted.
integrity.literature_priority: Best-knowledge comparisons only; indirect consequence from older maximal abelian ideal theory remains a stated risk.
integrity.proof_status: Self-contained mathematical argument; finite field checker is supportive but not universal proof.

scientific_limitations: Finite posets must have a least element for the stated innerness and cut classification.
The cut theorem and reduced-locus geometry require characteristic other than two.
Finite-field count and singular-locus dimension are determined explicitly for chains; characteristic-two enumeration is only claimed at matrix size four.
Scheme-theoretic nonreduced structure and universal priority against all unpublished/broader work are not addressed.
title: Cut geometry of square-zero derivations of incidence algebras
